title: Current and Wreck
author: Felix Almeida
blurb: Rosalind Coldharbour, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
